name: Family function
source: The recorded second-visit story, on its sample person V04. testdata/eval/ground-truth.json V04 (the miss list), which is also what the shipped judge lines read out of testdata/clef/judge-V04-family-function.json; the biggest issue is that recording's own choice. The pick and the runner-up are testdata/api/look.json's fix and runner_up, the contract's recorded example of this story; this pair is named from that fixture, not from the lowest-read-flag rule the other three stories state. The render is the earring flow's recorded result (testdata/youcam/earring-fetch.json, results/earring-jhumka-V04.jpg), the genuine YouCam output of V04 with the fix's own gold-jhumkas reference. The check this story shows its render on is the recording named in the check below, testdata/clef/check-clef-V04-to-V05.json: it read this sample's own selfie as the original, was asked about this fix's own criterion, ran on the check model the settings ship, and its three gate readings are this story's three facts at the shipped check lines. Its two look answers are the same two ways the fix's declared vocabulary in testdata/occasions/family-function.json and testdata/api/look.json give them. A discarded pass carries no check values, because none was recorded for it.
